text: A **2.19.0 project that has not yet been migrated** is detected and named as such by every command that reads the model -- never answered from an empty model as though the estate were empty. Measured at WP-06 on this repository (195 `info.md`, zero `thread.json`): `intent st list` returned **exit 0 with zero bytes on both streams** where v2 returns a 276-byte table, and `doctor` reported "2 findings across 0 threads" with both findings being view-skew derived from rendering an empty model against real files -- a confident false RED at the exact moment of a user's first contact with v3. AC-10.1 covers pre-2.19.0 and the migration itself is AC-00.8/AC-10.3; the state BETWEEN -- v3 installed, project at 2.19.0, canon not yet written -- was unspecified, and it is the state every project on earth is in the first time v3 runs. **Swept across the read surface at `2e490e5` (vc), and one root produces three symptoms, of which the second is worse than the one this AC was written from**: (a) **silent-empty** -- `st list` and `search` exit 0 with zero bytes on both streams; (b) **a confident false negative BY NAME** -- `wp list ST0056`, `ac status ST0056`, `at list ST0056` and `st show ST0056` each exit 1 with `error: no steel thread ST0056 in this project` while `intent/st/ST0056/info.md` sits on disk being edited; (c) **a false RED** -- `doctor`. (b) is the dangerous one: silence is ambiguous and invites a second look, whereas a specific denial is actionable, and the obvious action on "no steel thread ST0056" is to create it -- on top of the real one. In an agentic context that is a destructive read. The remaining read commands (`issues`, `todo`, `info`, `config`, `version`) refuse honestly as unwired and name the owing WP, which is the correct shape and the standard the three symptoms above should be held to
